basic_details.job_title: IIEST Shibpur Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.interview_date: Department of Earth Sciences, IIEST, Shibpur (To be announced)

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Maximum 28 years. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and Physically handicapped candidates.

qualification.details: Desirable Qualification: 1. M.Sc. in Applied Geology/ Geology/ Earth Sciences from a recognized University. 2. M.Sc. Specialization in Palaeontology/ Sedimentology. 3. Basic knowledge of palaeoclimate and palaeoenvironmental studies.

selection_process: The selection process comprises short listing followed by an interview.
Short listing may be done before the interview based on applications received.
The venue of the interview is the Department of Earth Sciences
Shibpur. Short listed candidates must provide valid email ID and phone number for communicating the date of interview.
how_to_apply: Prepare an application letter on plain paper.
Compile your recent bio-data, mark sheets, and certificates.
Send soft copies of the application letter, bio-data, mark sheets, and certificates through e-mail within 10 days of the publication of the advertisement to Dr. Lopamudra Roy, Project Investigator.
Send the email to [email protected] and [email protected].
Ensure the application mentions a valid e-mail ID and phone number for communication regarding the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. What is IIEST Shibpur Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Shibpur to fill 1 temporary Project Assistant position in the Department of Earth Sciences under a DST-INSPIRE sponsored project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit soft copies of the application by email is 19 October 2026, which is within 10 days of the publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. in Applied Geology/ Geology/ Earth Sciences from a recognized University. M.Sc. in relevant fields is a desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 28 years, with relaxation up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and Physically handicapped candidates.
